Page Setup for crukNavLink

Source: R/crukNavLink.R
crukNavLinkSetup.Rd

Loads the JavaScript helper used by crukNavLink and calls shinyjs::useShinyjs(). Place it once in the UI, for example in the header of bslib::page_navbar().

Usage

crukNavLinkSetup()

Value

An htmltools::tagList containing shinyjs::useShinyjs() and an htmlDependency that loads javascript/scrollToDivWhenReady.js from the package's www/ directory. The dependency is versioned according to the shinyCRUK package version.

See also

crukNavLink

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
bslib::page_navbar(
  id = "main_navbar",
  header = shiny::tagList(
    shiny::tags$head(crukTheme()),
    crukNavLinkSetup()
  )
)
} # }
